captions.fig8_roofline: Figure 8 (bonus): Batched GEMM search runs at 1109 GFLOP/s (AI~79 FLOP/B, 52% of the measured 2138 GFLOP/s compute roof) while per-query GEMV reaches only 204 GFLOP/s at AI=0.5, bounded by memory bandwidth (464 GB/s L3, 45 GB/s DRAM): batching queries is what moves the search from memory-bound to compute-bound.
captions.fig9_ann_tradeoff: Figure 9 (bonus): HNSW reaches recall@10 0.998 at 0.235 ms per query vs 0.537 ms for exact single-threaded search; our SimHash LSH needs to scan a large fraction of the corpus for high recall in 768 dimensions. At 20K documents exact search is already sub-millisecond, so ANN only pays off at much larger N.
